# transliteration result

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:transliterationResult`](gmeow-transliterationResult.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/transliterationResult>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/archaeological-evidence`](../../slices/archaeological-evidence.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The lexical form(s) produced by a transliteration. Non-functional: competing transliteration schemes may produce different forms for the same inscription, and those claims coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
